objective: Select exactly one mobile-oriented ViT-class model as the reference target for CPU-kicked ImageNet accuracy verification.

selected_model.name: MobileViT-S
selected_model.input_resolution: 256x256 center crop after 288x288 resize/rescale at inference
selected_model.pixel_order: BGR according to the Hugging Face model card
selected_model.license_note: Apple sample code license / Hugging Face license field: other

selection_rationale: It is explicitly mobile-oriented and combines CNN-style local processing with transformer global processing.
It is pretrained for 1000-class ImageNet classification and has published reference top-1/top-5 values.
Transformers exposes AutoImageProcessor and AutoModelForImageClassification for direct CPU reference execution.
The model is small enough to use as the first mobile ViT target before considering larger or newer mobile ViT variants.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: MobileViT-XXS
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: Smaller and useful later, but lower reference accuracy makes it a less useful first ImageNet correctness target.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: MobileViT-XS
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: Also viable, but MobileViT-S has the clearest high-accuracy reference while remaining mobile-sized.

rejected_or_deferred_candidates.name: TinyViT or newer mobile ViT variants
rejected_or_deferred_candidates.reason: Could be stronger, but would require additional source and preprocessing selection before the first CPU-kick/ImageNet path exists.

non_claims: not top-1 or top-5 accuracy measurement
